joint_servo.name: ST3215 12 V, DFRobot SER0070; Feetech ST-3215-C018 specification
joint_servo.feedback_qualification: Load is PWM duty proxy, not joint torque. Current is a separate feedback channel. No documented constant-current mode for this SKU.
joint_servo.variant_conflicts: Manufacturer PDF says core motor/copper gears; retail prose says coreless/copper-aluminum and another manufacturer product page says steel. Do not assert identical internals across batches. Match 12 V SKU, horn geometry and measured behavior. Vendor voltage ranges differ; proposal uses 12 V bench / 3S up to 12.6 V, within overlapping published ranges.

wheel_motor.name: Waveshare DCGM-3865-12V-EN-240RPM, SKU 22346
wheel_motor.encoder_conflict: Current official site: 13 PPR × 42 = 546; older Waveshare manual: 11 × 42 = 462. Neither is automatically the quadrature x4 count. Measure delivered unit and counting convention.
wheel_motor.mass_qualification: Shop listing weight; net versus packed mass is not specified. Used only as a provisional accounting proxy, not a verified motor mass.

hs_servo.name: Waveshare ST3215-HS
hs_servo.qualification: No validated wheel reversal response, loaded speed, continuous torque or end-to-end control latency for this application.
